name: Chūō (Tokyo, Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Chūō ward emblem in white: a stylised device of a ring with four knobbed arms, like a wheel.
history: Municipal flag of Chūō, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 31 July 1948.

features.role: Chūō ward emblem — a stylised device of a ring with four knobbed arms, like a wheel
